message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: illegal discharge of waste water with heavy metal pollution. In Chinese law, relevant crimes: "非法排放污染物罪" under Environmental Protection Law, criminal law article 338? Actually Criminal Law article 338: "违反国家规定，擅自排放、倾倒、处置危险废物或者其他有毒有害物质，造成严重后果的，处五年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处五年以上有期徒刑”。 Also article 338 for "非法排放污染物罪". Also possibly "污染环境罪". The fact: waste water with chromium and nickel exceeding standards, causing pollution. So crime: "非法排放污染物罪". Also maybe "违反环境保护法的行政处罚" but that's not criminal. So only one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法排放污染物罪<eoa>
